title: Contextual audit exports, saved query sharing, and CSV/JSON streaming
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Customers need a dependable audit-console export flow that respects RBAC v2 permissions, preserves SSO context, and supports large result sets with pagination without timing out or returning partial/incorrect data. Current exports time out for large queries, saved query sharing is primitive (only via export links), and CSV/JSON downloads do not honor contextual redaction rules introduced in RBAC v2. Goal: deliver a contextual export feature that (1) streams CSV/JSON/NDJSON for large result sets with cursor/resumable downloads, (2) enforces RBAC v2 scoping and per-role redaction at export time, (3) preserves SSO user/context metadata in exported payloads when permitted, (4) provides saved query templates with shareable scopes (private/team/org) and audit trail for who executed/modified them.
acceptance_criteria: Console can start a CSV or NDJSON streaming export for queries returning >1M rows without UI timeout
Exports enforce RBAC v2 filters: rows and fields not visible to the requestor are redacted or omitted per policy
Saved queries support three scopes (private/team/org) and respect RBAC v2 role inheritance when shared
Pagination uses server-side stable snapshot with a cursor token that is resumable for up to 24 hours
Export includes optional SSO context block when the executor has export-rights and audit logging records the SSO identity
Export formats: CSV (comma-escaped), JSON array (bounded), NDJSON streaming (recommended for large sets), and a streaming HTTP endpoint that supports Range and resume via cursor
End-to-end e2e tests cover export correctness, redaction rules, pagination/resume, and saved query permission changes
comments: 2025-03-02 - PM review: Agreed on RBAC-first approach. Need legal sign-off for including SSO identity in exports.
2025-03-04 - Design feedback: Recommend NDJSON streaming by default for >100k rows and 'Download as CSV (experimental)' toggle.
2025-03-06 - Eng note: Implemented cursor snapshot service and background export worker. Prototype fails on table joins producing inconsistent rows; investigating consistency guarantee.
2025-03-10 - Security: Confirmed redaction rules mapping for RBAC v2 roles. Added tests for PII field policies.
2025-03-14 - QA: Manual test pass for 250k row NDJSON stream. CSV escaping edge cases found for multi-line message columns; fixed serializer to RFC4180 compliance.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for redaction and permission filtering. 2) Integration tests: start export for synthetic large dataset and assert streaming completeness + resume via cursor. 3) Permission matrix tests for saved-query scopes and role changes. 4) Load test: simulate 50 concurrent large exports to validate worker autoscaling and SLOs.
rollout_plan: alpha: rollout to internal org + prod sandbox (2 weeks)
beta: opt-in toggle for 10% of orgs, monitor CPU/IO and export success rates (1 week)
ga: enable by default with telemetry-based alerts and rollback path (2 days)
pagination_strategy: Stable snapshot + opaque cursor. The UI will page with a server-issued cursor token. Cursor encodes snapshot id and offset; server keeps snapshots for 24 hours. Resumption returns 409 if snapshot expired with link to recreate snapshot asynchronously.
saved_query_sharing: Saved queries are stored with an ACL that maps to RBAC v2 principals. Scopes: private (owner only), team (team members inheriting roles), org (any principal with audit:view exports). Changing role membership invalidates shared-query cache and triggers reevaluation on next execute.
audit_retention_handling: Exports respect retention windows: rows older than a tenant's retention policy are omitted from exports unless an admin-level override is explicitly requested and recorded. When redaction is required, fields are replaced with '<redacted>' and we include a documentation header in the export explaining the applied policy.
estimation_notes: 8 points: backend worker + snapshot service (5), RBAC redaction integration (2), UI saved-query share + streaming client (1). Risk: retention overrides and legal approval for SSO identity inclusion may add scope.
